Where does SQL dialect transpilation / dialect normalization happen in this SQLMesh checkout? Identify the primary module and the key entrypoint symbol. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <module-prefixed symbol>
file: <path relative to repo root>
lines: <start-end>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Trace what happens when a user runs `sqlmesh plan`. Start from the Click CLI command. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
cli_symbol: <CLI function qualified_name>
callee_qualified_name: <plan method qualified_name>
file: <file of the plan method>
lines: <start-end of the plan method>
evidence: <one short sentence>

List every call site of GenericContext.render / Context.render under sqlmesh/ and web/. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <callee module-prefixed name>
callers: <every call site with its file path and line number>
evidence: <one short sentence>

In sqlmesh/core/snapshot/evaluator.py, name EvaluationStrategy's qualified_name, its direct base class, and its direct subclasses. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <EvaluationStrategy module-prefixed name>
parent_classes: <comma-separated direct bases>
child_classes: <comma-separated direct subclass names>
file: sqlmesh/core/snapshot/evaluator.py
evidence: <one short sentence>

Identify the central `create_model_kind` helper and the call site in model definition construction that would break if it were renamed. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <create_model_kind module-prefixed name>
file: <caller file path relative to repo root>
lines: <caller line number>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Find every place the exception ConflictingPlanError is raised. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
qualified_name: <the exception's module-prefixed name>
raise_locations: <every raise site with its file path and line number>
evidence: <one short sentence>

What is the public API surface of the sqlmesh.core.model package? List every Python module file under that package (filenames only) and every public name re-exported from sqlmesh/core/model/__init__.py. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
directory: sqlmesh/core/model
modules: <comma-separated module filenames>
public_symbols: <comma-separated exported names>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Which files import from sqlmesh.core.dialect under sqlmesh/ and web/? For each importer, list the imported symbols. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
imported_module: sqlmesh/core/dialect.py
importers: <one line per importer as path — comma-separated symbols>
evidence: <one short sentence>

Summarize the plan / diff subsystem. Name the plan package directory, the sibling context-diff module path, and the four primary types. Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
directory: <plan package directory>
related_modules: <comma-separated paths>

evidence: <one short sentence>

Where is the CLI flag `--forward-only` handled end-to-end? Answer with exactly these fields on their own lines:
